note: Passage 3705 (Pro 1:9) — the parents' instruction becomes 'a graceful garland'. chen read as the favor/grace that heeded instruction confers on the person (effect-metaphor).

dims.v: grace — the favor and beauty heeded instruction confers, a garland of grace
the grace/favor that adorns the one who receives the parents' teaching
the fruit of hearing (1:8): obedience wears as grace and honour
chen here is an EFFECT, not an operation: the inner honour/favour that received discipline confers, imaged as an ornament. The metaphor (garland, pendants) grounds an interior good in adornment.
